investigation.summary: All 3/3 smoke records finalized inside a typed decode timeout for BOTH the control and confirm arms at this fresh seed (100005), at the same 1,755,760-param size that decoded successfully in ~6.5-7.2s per arm one cycle earlier (c4, different seed). Verified _effective_record_decode_timeout (src/slm_training/harnesses/model_build/eval_runner.py:884) allocates a fair, budget-aware per-record share and is already covered by tests/test_harnesses/model_build/test_eval_metric_semantics.py::test_eval_wall_fairly_caps_each_remaining_record -- no defect found there. Confirmed tests/test_scripts/test_run_autotrain_continuous.py::test_replayed_dual_arm_timeouts_remain_inconclusive_and_require_repair intentionally locks in that a symmetric (both-arm) finalized decode timeout must stay climb_state=inconclusive and keep demanding repair_harness rather than silently retiring to a new hypothesis -- a routing change to auto-retire dual-arm timeouts was drafted, found to violate this existing contract, and reverted (not shipped).
investigation.root_cause: unresolved: either (a) seed-dependent worst-case decode/parser behavior for this candidate size at seed 100005, or (b) this sandbox's per-run CPU throughput plus the campaign's per-experiment wall budget leaves too little decode headroom at 1,755,760 params. Not distinguished in this session.
investigation.not_a_fix: No code change was made; the driver's existing dual-arm-timeout contract (require repair, never auto-retire) was verified intact.
investigation.recommended_next_step: Replay the identical frozen -confirm arm (retry_measurement, already queued) to test whether the timeout reproduces at the same seed; if it reproduces twice, profile compiler-tree decode specifically for seed 100005 at this param count in a dedicated follow-up session.

next_priority: replay the identical frozen confirm arm; if reproduced, hand off to improve-openui-harnesses for compiler-tree decode profiling at seed 100005
